t: This is the Savoy Hotel, on the Strand, one of London's grand luxury hotels. Richard D'Oyly Carte built it with the profits from his Gilbert and Sullivan operas, and it opened on 6 August 1889. Thomas Collcutt was the architect. It was the first hotel in Britain with electric lights throughout, electric lifts, and bathrooms in most of its rooms. The composer Peter Warlock was born here, and the actor Richard Harris, the Irish star of the British New Wave, lived here.
